mathematics.independent_check: Independent frozen-segment check: horizontal runs are A=4+4, B=3+1+1+3, C=2+2+2+2, D=eight ones. Each segment has |dy|=dx>0 and each route has total dx=8, so every length is exactly 8*sqrt(2). Dashed ink gaps do not shorten the geometric route.
mathematics.ambiguity_risk: low_to_moderate: standard route interpretation uniquely gives E; making complete alternatives dashed can suggest auxiliary/incomplete paths and adds avoidable semantic burden. Endpoints, corners and grids still allow all routes to be read.

visual_review.clutter: No new geometric line or point; four small grids remain discernible. A is much more prominent and B/C/D dashes add fragmentation at the existing small scale.
visual_review.source_comparison: Coordinates and the E 'All routes are equal' text are preserved from source and formal redraw.
